analysis.thread_scaling_pattern: Increasing CPU threads above 24 degrades generation rate while gate-pack and VRAM-cache counters remain identical to accepted route, so the regression is consistent with CPU fallback scheduling/memory-bandwidth contention rather than cache admission drift.
analysis.implication_for_10_tok_s: Thread-count tuning alone does not reopen the CPU fallback route and does not affect the prior hard-bound requiring a fundamentally faster exact microkernel or a source/representation reduction.

decision.next_step: Do not repeat thread-count sweeps on the same accepted route unless a source/kernel change changes the CPU fallback scaling model. Continue only with a new external high-acceptance artifact, stronger representation/placement proof, or exact kernel/dataflow proof as required by the plan.
